local NAME_X, NAME_Y = 285.6776, 12

local placements = {{PREFIX, PREFIX[2], PREFIX[3]}}
local cursor, previous, characterCount = 0, nil, 0
local unsupported = false
for _, codepoint in utf8.codes(NICKNAME) do
    characterCount = characterCount + 1
    if characterCount > 64 then
        warn("CowBoosts: nickname shortened to 64 characters")
        break
    end
    if not GLYPHS[codepoint] then codepoint = 63; unsupported = true end
    if previous then cursor = cursor + (KERNING[previous .. "," .. codepoint] or 0) end
    local glyph = GLYPHS[codepoint]
    if glyph[4] > 0 then
        table.insert(placements, {glyph, NAME_X + cursor + glyph[2], NAME_Y + glyph[3]})
    end
    cursor = cursor + glyph[1]
    previous = codepoint
end
if unsupported then warn("CowBoosts: unsupported characters were replaced with ?") end
local minX, minY, maxX, maxY = 0, 0, 0, 0
for _, placement in ipairs(placements) do
    minX = math.min(minX, placement[2])
    minY = math.min(minY, placement[3])
    maxX = math.max(maxX, placement[2] + placement[1][4])
    maxY = math.max(maxY, placement[3] + placement[1][5])
end
local ART_WIDTH = math.ceil(maxX - minX + 12)
local ART_HEIGHT = math.ceil(maxY - minY + 6)

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local playerGui = Players.LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

local widthFraction = 0.55 -- Initial fraction of the screen width
local MIN_WIDTH, MAX_WIDTH = 0.12, 0.95

local old = playerGui:FindFirstChild("CowBoostsOverlay")
if old then old:Destroy() end

local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
gui.Name = "CowBoostsOverlay"
gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
gui.IgnoreGuiInset = true
gui.DisplayOrder = 10000
gui.ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling
gui.Enabled = false

local container = Instance.new("Frame")
container.Name = "NicknameContainer"
container.BackgroundTransparency = 1
container.BorderSizePixel = 0
container.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
container.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.80)
container.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(ART_WIDTH, ART_HEIGHT)
container.Active = true
container.Parent = gui

local uiScale = Instance.new("UIScale")
uiScale.Parent = container

local function updateSize()
	local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
	local screenWidth = camera and camera.ViewportSize.X or 1280
	uiScale.Scale = math.max(0.05, screenWidth * widthFraction / ART_WIDTH)
end
updateSize()
gui.Parent = playerGui


local count = 0
for _, placement in ipairs(placements) do
    local glyph = placement[1]
    local baseX, baseY = placement[2] - minX, placement[3] - minY
    for color, x, y, w, h in glyph[6]:gmatch("(%d+),(%d+),(%d+),(%d+),(%d+);") do
        local paint = COLORS[tonumber(color)]
        local part = Instance.new("Frame")
        part.Name = "Glyph"
        part.BorderSizePixel = 0
        part.BackgroundColor3 = paint[1]
        part.BackgroundTransparency = 1 - paint[2]
        part.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(baseX + tonumber(x), baseY + tonumber(y))
        part.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(tonumber(w), tonumber(h))
        part.Active = false
        part.Selectable = false
        part.ZIndex = paint[3]
        part.Parent = container
        count = count + 1
        if count % 300 == 0 then
            task.wait()
            if not gui.Parent then return end
        end
    end
end

	local p, size = container.AbsolutePosition, container.AbsoluteSize
	local margin = 28
	return point.X >= p.X - margin and point.X <= p.X + size.X + margin
		and point.Y >= p.Y - margin and point.Y <= p.Y + size.Y + margin
end

local function moveFrom(start, delta)
	container.Position = UDim2.new(
		start.X.Scale, start.X.Offset + delta.X,
		start.Y.Scale, start.Y.Offset + delta.Y
	)
end

local function restartGesture()
	gestureStartPosition = container.Position
	gestureStartWidth = widthFraction
	if #touchOrder == 1 then
		gestureStartCenter = touchPositions[touchOrder[1]]
	elseif #touchOrder == 2 then
		local p1 = touchPositions[touchOrder[1]]
		local p2 = touchPositions[touchOrder[2]]
		gestureStartCenter = (p1 + p2) / 2
		gestureStartDistance = math.max(12, (p1 - p2).Magnitude)
	else
		gestureStartCenter = nil
	end
end

local beganConnection = UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
	local kind = input.UserInputType
	local point = point2(input)
	if kind == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
		-- Only touches starting on/next to the nickname control it.
		if #touchOrder >= 2 or not overNickname(point) then return end
		mouseDragging = false
		touchPositions[input] = point
		table.insert(touchOrder, input)
		restartGesture()
	elseif kind == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 and #touchOrder == 0 and overNickname(point) then
		mouseDragging = true
		mouseStartPoint = point
		mouseStartPosition = container.Position
	end
end)

local movedConnection = UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
	if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch and touchPositions[input] then
		touchPositions[input] = point2(input)
		if #touchOrder == 1 then
			moveFrom(gestureStartPosition, touchPositions[touchOrder[1]] - gestureStartCenter)
		elseif #touchOrder == 2 then
			local p1 = touchPositions[touchOrder[1]]
			local p2 = touchPositions[touchOrder[2]]
			local distance = math.max(1, (p1 - p2).Magnitude)
			widthFraction = math.clamp(gestureStartWidth * distance / gestureStartDistance, MIN_WIDTH, MAX_WIDTH)
			updateSize()
			moveFrom(gestureStartPosition, (p1 + p2) / 2 - gestureStartCenter)
		end
	elseif input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement and mouseDragging then
		moveFrom(mouseStartPosition, point2(input) - mouseStartPoint)
	end
end)

local endedConnection = UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
	if touchPositions[input] then
		touchPositions[input] = nil
		for i = #touchOrder, 1, -1 do
			if touchOrder[i] == input then table.remove(touchOrder, i); break end
		end
		restartGesture()
	elseif input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
		mouseDragging = false
	end
end)

-- Preserve relative size when rotating the tablet.
local viewportConnection
local function bindCamera()
	if viewportConnection then
		viewportConnection:Disconnect()
		viewportConnection = nil
	end
	local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
	if camera then
		viewportConnection = camera:GetPropertyChangedSignal("ViewportSize"):Connect(updateSize)
	end
	updateSize()
end
local cameraConnection = workspace:GetPropertyChangedSignal("CurrentCamera"):Connect(bindCamera)
bindCamera()

gui.Destroying:Connect(function()
	beganConnection:Disconnect()
	movedConnection:Disconnect()
	endedConnection:Disconnect()
	cameraConnection:Disconnect()
	if viewportConnection then viewportConnection:Disconnect() end
end)

gui.Enabled = true
